549-2685-4186-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-2685-4186-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-4659-5468-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4659-5468-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

891-2961-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, False Demise triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

240-5231-5470-6965.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

240-4460-5231-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2607-7276.manaNeeded: {W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable if Dark Leo & Shredder isn't on the battlefield
2607-7276.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block Dark Leo & Shredder if it's on the battlefield, or another creature you control otherwise.
Dark Leo & Shredder doesn't have summoning sickness if it's on the battlefield.
You control at least four Ninjas.
2607-7276.description:
Declare Dark Leo & Shredder as an attacker if it's on the battlefield, or another creature you control otherwise.
If Dark Leo & Shredder isn't on the battlefield, when the declared creature is unblocked, cast Dark Leo & Shredder either from your hand or from the command zone for its sneak cost by paying {W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable and returning the unblocked attacker to your hand.
Deal combat damage using Dark Leo & Shredder, triggering its second ability, creating a 1/1 Ninja creature token and causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing the opponent to lose the rest of their life total.
2607-7276.notes: You must control four Ninjas when Dark Leo & Shredder deals combat damage. Notably, if it isn't on the battlefield, you must control five total Ninjas if the attacker you will be returning is a Ninja.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4365-7175.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2921-4871-5220-5447.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
2921-4871-5220-5447.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1802-1873-5356.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Barbed Servitor.
1802-1873-5356.description:
Cast Gideon's Sacrifice by paying {W}, targeting Barbed Servitor
Deal damage to Barbed Servitor
Barbed Servitor and Fiendlash trigger.
Resolve the Barbed Servitor trigger, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the damage dealt to Barbed Servitor.
Resolve the Fiendlash trigger, targeting you, but dealing damage to Barbed Servitor instead due to Gideon's Sacrifice.
Repeat from step 3.

2829-6837-6871-6879.description:
Cast Three Tree Mascot by paying {2}.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Three Tree Mascot.
When Three Tree Mascot dies, Haru triggers, returning Three Tree Mascot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1308-4571-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1308-4571-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Life // Death
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

3767-3918-3941-7040.description:
Activate Trazyn using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

224-1846-1980-6618-6657.easyPrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
224-1846-1980-6618-6657.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Relm's Sketching by paying its mana cost, targeting an Island you control.
Swarm Intelligence triggers. 
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Swarm Intelligence ability.
Resolve the copy of Swarm Intelligence's ability, copying the Relm's Sketching spell, targeting an Island you control that enters the battlefield untapped.
Resolve the copy of Relm's Sketching, creating a token copy of the targeted Island.
When the Island token enters, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Gogo.
Activate the Island token by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4636-4772-5770.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat from step 2.

3464-3657-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 5 life this turn.
3464-3657-4188.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3464-3657-4188.notes: If you get infinite mana, you can repeat steps 2-5 infinitely to untap any other creature(s)

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6633-6664.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
3259-6633-6664.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2292-4826-5003-6644.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

851-1563-2457-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
851-1563-2457-4068.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

457-4659-6465.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} plus {1} for each time you've cast James / Follow Him from the command zone this game, plus commander tax if applicable
457-4659-6465.description:
Cast Follow Him either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{U}{U} plus {1} for each time you've cast James / Follow Him from the command zone this game, plus commander tax, if applicable.
Resolve Follow Him, creating at least three Clue tokens and returning Follow Him to the command zone from exile.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the tapped Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2 until you control no Clues.
Cast Follow Him from the command zone using all available mana, creating a number of Clue tokens and returning Follow Him to the command zone from exile.
Repeat from step 3.
457-4659-6465.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may cast James infinitely if desired. You can also activate the Clues to draw cards and/or Urza's ability.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

372-5530-5913.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Another Round exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-5530-5913.description:
Cast Another Round by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Pinnacle Monk and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Pinnacle Monk trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Another Round.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Pinnacle Monk and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

586-4050-5626-6112.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding one mana of any color.
When Priest of Gix dies, Fumulus's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Insect and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

3305-3967-4022-4772-5926.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating two token copies of each creature card in your graveyard that are 1/1 Insects.
Put all but one of the Grist, Voracious Larva tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, each Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and each Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve both Hidden Herbalist triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

427-4067-5765.notablePrerequisites: Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
427-4067-5765.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding {C} for each card you've drawn this turn.
Activate Prophet of Distrotion by paying {3}{C}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.
Eventually, Kydele will produce extra mana, and you may repeat step 2 as mana allows.

4094-4518-5554.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
4094-4518-5554.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double all tokens you create this turn.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat from step 2.

152-3621-4659.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 targeting any artifact you control.

1580-1636-1785.notablePrerequisites: Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
1580-1636-1785.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

215-4231-4634-4772.description:
Cast Wavesifter for its evoke cost by paying {G}{U}.
Wavesifter enters the battlefield, triggering itself and its evoke ability.
Resolve the first Wavesifter trigger, creating four Clue, four Treasure, and four Food tokens.
Activate the four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wavesifter from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Wavesifter trigger from step 2, failing to sacrifice Wavesifter due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Repeat.

1110-3748.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Hornet Nest indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Hornet Nest.
1110-3748.description:
Give Hornet Nest indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Hornet Nest.
Hornet Nest triggers, creating at least one 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks, dealing 1 damage to Hornet Nest.
Repeat from step 3.
